system.description:
ARCHIVIST UTILITY WARDING
Archivist Specialist Spell
Cast 1 AP (verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 willing creature
Duration 1 minute

You recite a compact theological formula that reveals the structure of divine power an instant before it takes hold.
The first time during the duration that the target attempts a saving throw against a Divinity spell or magical effect granted directly by a Deific Aspect, it gains Advantage on that saving throw. Doctrinal Ward then ends.

Warping Options:
+1 PP: Target one additional willing creature.
+3 PP: The ward may grant Advantage twice before ending.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10. Advantage on the target's first save against a Divinity spell or Aspect-granted effect — a scoped row that you remove once used.
